description.narrative: Internally Displaced Persons (IDPs) (70%), Host community (30%), needs based and subject to change.

Project outcome: Emergency basic needs of crisis affected IDPs and Host communities living in conflict affected and hard-to-reach areas are coveredOutcome 1: Immediate needs of crisis affected populations in conflict affected communities in IDP hosting and hard-to-reach areas are coveredOutcome 2: Shelter and winterization needs of the displaced or economically deprived populations are coveredOutcome 3: Conflict-affected populations, including children, have greater access to services and capacity to handle conflict-related trauma.

WHH together with Cesvi, and Concern Worldwide will expand its programs to targeted oblasts in eastern Ukraine with large influx of IDPs and with people not able to access life saving services and assistance. This project will provide emergency humanitarian assistance to conflict affected populations from November 2022 to December 2023.
